title: Deterministic risk classification before planning
approach: Resolve changed paths against policy riskRules first, then write a plan that references the recorded classification. Downstream gates bind to plan.json and re-invalidate when its digest changes.

steps.description: Write the classifier and table-driven tests in an isolated worktree.
Capture format, vet, and test output as evidence.
Review the candidate independently and record review-findings.json.

testStrategy: Offline table-driven tests only; no network calls and no real credentials.

rollback.plan: Revert the isolated commit and discard the worktree; no data changes are involved.
